name: approval-desk
title: Approval desk
subtitle: Pending decisions, overdue work and owner workload

sections.title: Pending approvals
sections.sql: select title,workflow,step,assignee,due_at,overdue from approval_inbox order by due_at

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select title,issue,owner,due_at from workflow_attention order by issue,title

sections.title: Workload
sections.sql: select assignee,count(*) as pending,count(*) filter(where overdue) as overdue from approval_inbox group by assignee order by pending desc

sections.title: Volume and review dates
sections.sql: select * from workflow_summary order by name
